response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — critical for this role. His DLang and Node.js background shows systems thinking, but the core tech stack and domain expertise (routing tiles, map optimization, real-time traffic integration) are not demonstrated.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and deliver systems at scale
Strong background in testing, CI/CD, and developer tooling with documented workshops
concerns: No demonstrated commercial experience with C++ or Rust in routing or geospatial data pipelines
Lacks explicit experience with distributed systems concepts like fault tolerance or service discovery in production routing contexts
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, with minimal evidence of low-latency systems or map tiling expertise
